correctness.rationale: Each tree-compatible outgoing assignment has exactly one mutual edge; summing its conductance products yields the exact law. Every-spanning-tree exchange gives the iff rigidity. Differentiating a reduced weighted Laplacian determinant proves nonpositive edge-indicator covariances and the TV bound. Independent triangle-block CLT yields the nonzero asymptotic lower-bound constant. Six small finite networks independently checked with exact rational enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural complete strong-metric comparison for graph-valued one-out versus weighted spanning-tree sampling. The density, necessary-and-sufficient exact equality classification, graph-independent O(n^{-1/2}) convergence under bounded conductance ratio, and an explicit family proving optimal order are structurally meaningful and answer a question distinct from unconditioned Wasserstein approximation. No unrelated special parameter slice or routine finite recomputation.
